integrity: The convergence laws are analytically proved from exact group images and standard central limit theorems; finite checks are diagnostics, not proofs of infinite limits.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to two fixed coprime integer circle multipliers, powers of their product for the initial grid, and a shared iid switching word; no spatial rounding perturbations or claims for generic nonlinear dynamics.
title: Gaussian crossover of random grid collapse under coprime expanding maps
